spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (चुणति)
To cut, to pierce or divide.

r. 10th cl. (चूणयति)
To contract, to close or shrink.

f. (-ण्टा)
A small well or reservoir near a well.
E.
चुडि to be low or shallow, affixes अङ् and टाप्; also चुड्डी, the fem. affix being ङीष्.

f. (-ण्टी)
A small well: see the preceding.
